claims.statement: The arrangements for Tom Allen's fight with Joe Goss were completed in Cincinnati for September 7, 1876.
claims.excerpt: Goss and Tom. Allen have been completed

claims.statement: Tom Kelly of St. Louis and Arthur Chambers of Philadelphia were to second Tom Allen in the fight.
claims.excerpt: onded by Tom Kelly of St. Louis and Arthur Chambers of Philadelphia.

claims.statement: Jack Looney of St. Louis arrived with a party of 25 men, saying Allen must be whipped.
claims.excerpt: Jack Looney of St. Louis, and a party

claims.statement: Joe Coburn said that although Allen was the better man, the fight would be fixed for Goss to get the money.
claims.excerpt: but it will be fixed for Goss to get the money.

claims.statement: Tom Kelly wired that a rumour said Allen would not get fair play and the best he could get was a draw.
claims.excerpt: rumor here this morning that Allen will not get fair play

claims.statement: Tom Allen had already left for the fighting ground, with Joe Goss to follow.
claims.excerpt: Alien has already left for the

fights.excerpt: Goss and Tom. Allen have been completed
fights.notes: Dad Ryan of St. Louis expected as referee. Goss to weigh about 164 lb and Allen about 178 lb. No result given.

notes: Dispatch datelined Cincinnati, September 6. Kelly's rumor is one side's claim.
